svg.text: Tools let an LLM do what it can't compute, never saw, or can't reach. Early work trained a

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: model per API (Toolformer, Gorilla). Now standard schemas (function calling, MCP) let

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: any model use any tool, and pass^k checks whether it does so reliably.

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: 工具让 LLM 做到它算不了、没见过、够不着的事。早期方法要为每个 API 训练模型（Toolformer、

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: Gorilla）；现在用标准接口（函数调用、MCP），任何模型都能用任何工具，再用 pass^k 检验是否
